description: This file defines enums, structs, and helper functions related to execution approvals and security policies within a macOS application. It manages allowlists, approval decisions, and associated security configurations, as well as utility functions for handling these policies and related data structures.

classes.name: SkillBinsCache
classes.description: An actor that caches information about available skill binaries and their paths, including trust indexes and refresh logic.

classes.name: SkillBinTrustIndex
classes.description: A data structure that holds sets of skill binary names and their normalized file paths identified as trusted.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the exec-approvals JSON file in the application's state directory.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Reads and decodes the exec-approvals JSON file, returning the parsed structure or a default if loading fails.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Encodes and writes the exec-approvals configuration to disk.

methods.name: ensureFile
methods.description: Ensures the configuration file exists and is valid, loading or creating as needed.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the current approval configuration for a given agent ID, ensuring defaults are applied.

methods.name: normalizeAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Normalizes a list of allowlist entries for validity, optionally dropping invalid entries.
